title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
**The challenge
   

  

 You’re leaving the safety of Jupyter notebooks to wrestle with the tension of stochastic models in a deterministic financial world. You’ll encounter a codebase processing millions of transactions where "it works on my machine" is not a valid defence, bridging the gap between tutorial implementations and high\-scale systems to build co\-intelligence that decides and executes without a human holding its hand.
   

  

 See what we’re shipping at Deriv.
   

  

**Why this matters
   

  

**Deriv's mission is Trading for Anyone, Anywhere, Anytime. Millions of traders, around the clock. This scale demands AI that works in production, not prototypes that demo well.
   

  

 We're already here: AI resolving 65%\+ of customer enquiries, writing and reviewing code, processing invoices, and screening candidates. Not experiments. Production systems you'll help extend.
   

  

**Why Deriv
   

  

 Learn by building, not by watching. Here's where you'll do it:
   

  

* Customer experience: Building AI that handles conversation, outreach, and lifecycle management.
* Developer infrastructure: Building the systems that build systems (Spec\-to\-PR, QA automation, security scanning).
* Business functions: Building the AI that runs Deriv (finance workflows, HR automation).


 Your placement depends on team needs and your interests. You'll likely focus on one area but touch several, with real ownership and support along the way.
   

  

**What you'll do
   

  

* Build features that go to production: You won't just write scripts; you'll ship code that runs in live environments.
* Work across three paradigms: You'll learn to combine deterministic systems (code), predictive models (ML), and agentic systems (LLMs).
* Learn from failure: You'll understand why guardrails matter when a 1% error rate means thousands of wrong decisions.
* Pair with experienced engineers: You'll own small features end\-to\-end with guidance from senior mentors.


**Who you are
   

  

* You write code that runs: Python or another language you genuinely enjoy. You know syntax is easy; making things work in production is where it gets interesting.
* You've touched ML or LLMs: Courses, side projects, experiments. Enough to know what you don't know yet.
* You deliver reliably: You distinguish urgent from important and keep your promises on delivery dates.
* You're comfortable being wrong: You'll ship code that breaks. That's how you learn—if you can admit it and fix it.


**Tech stack
   

  

* Languages: Python, TypeScript
* AI/ML: OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, LangGraph, Custom ML Pipelines
* Infrastructure: AWS, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, LangFuse


**The honest reality
   

  

 This is demanding work. You'll face problems without clear answers. You'll ship code that breaks and fix it under pressure. Some weeks will be frustrating.
   

  

 But you'll ship AI that runs—not demos, not prototypes. You'll see your work handling real transactions. And you'll grow fast.****************

title: Senior Backend Developer / AI Engineer
description:
**Company** 



  


 We are a Berlin\-based B2C fintech operating in stealth, founded by two repeat founders (YC alum, exit) with prior 10\+ year careers in investment banking and strategy consulting, respectively. We recently raised investment to assemble a 15 people, exceptionally strong core team.
 


  


 Our culture is built on ownership and clarity. We align with you on vision, then set KPIs and required resources together—and then trust your drive and expertise.
 


  


**The Opportunity** 



  


 As a Senior Backend Developer / AI Engineer, you will work alongside our CTO on building and evolving our AI\-powered fintech product. The core architecture is in place, providing a solid foundation to build upon as we integrate advanced LLM capabilities, establish AI pipelines, implement intelligent automation, and ship production\-ready AI features. You'll be instrumental in shaping how we leverage AI to transform financial services, with significant autonomy to design and implement cutting\-edge solutions.
 


  

 Tasks
   


**What you will work on on daily basis** 



  

  
* Designing and implementing LLM\-powered features and intelligent automation workflows
  
* Building robust AI pipelines with proper orchestration, error handling, and monitoring
  
* Developing RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) systems for financial data processing
  
* Implementing and optimizing vector search and embedding strategies
  
* Creating evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs and maintaining quality standards
  
* Building prompt management systems and optimizing LLM interactions for cost and performance
  
* Integrating multiple AI models and managing model versioning/deployment
  
* Ensuring AI safety, reliability, and compliance in financial applications
  


  

 Requirements
   


**Hard Requirements** 



  

  
* LLM Framework Expertise: Deep hands\-on experience with LangChain.js, LangGraph for JavaScript, or similar Node.js\-based LLM frameworks. You understand agent architectures, chain composition, memory management, and can build complex multi\-step AI workflows in TypeScript/JavaScript.
  
* Workflow Orchestration: Production experience with Temporal .io (TypeScript SDK), Bull/BullMQ, or similar Node.js\-compatible orchestration solutions. You know how to build reliable, long\-running workflows with proper error handling, retries, and state management.
  
* Vector Database \& RAG Systems: Proven experience implementing RAG architectures using vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or pgvector) with Node.js clients. You understand embedding models, similarity search, and hybrid retrieval strategies.
  
* Node.js \& TypeScript Mastery: Expert\-level proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript with extensive experience integrating AI services (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere APIs). You're comfortable with streams, async patterns, WebSockets for real\-time AI responses, and optimizing for latency.
  


  


**Additional Technical Skills** 



  

  
* Experience with prompt engineering and prompt management systems accessible from Node.js
  
* Hands\-on experience with AI model APIs and their Node.js SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, Replicate)
  
* Knowledge of AI observability tools with Node.js integration (LangSmith, Helicone, or custom solutions)
  
* Proficiency with streaming architectures and Server\-Sent Events (SSE) for real\-time AI responses
  
* Understanding of AI safety, hallucination detection, and output validation techniques
  
* Familiarity with AI evaluation frameworks and automated testing of LLM outputs
  


  


**Mindset \& Approach** 



  

  
* AI\-Native Thinking: You think in terms of probabilistic systems, understand LLM limitations, and know how to design robust systems around non\-deterministic outputs.
  
* Pragmatic Innovation: You balance cutting\-edge AI capabilities with production requirements—knowing when to use simple solutions vs. complex AI architectures.
  
* Ownership Mentality: You're proactive, resourceful, and accountable for your work—you don't wait to be told what to do.
  
* Team Player: You collaborate well with others, can explain AI concepts to non\-technical stakeholders, and elevate those around you.
  
* Quality\-Focused: You understand the importance of evaluation, testing, and monitoring in AI systems and build with observability in mind.
  
* Continuous Learner: You stay current with the rapidly evolving AI landscape, experiment with new models and techniques, and are energized by pushing the boundaries of what's possible.
  


  

 Benefits
   


**Compensation \& How We Work** 



  

  
* Competitive salary commensurate with experience (€80k\-€110k\+ depending on seniority)
  
* On\-site in Berlin\-Mitte, with flexible remote work as you see fit (typically 3\-4 days in office, flexible on specific days)
  
* High autonomy, low politics, fast decision\-making—we value impact over process

If you're excited about the role but don't meet 100% of the criteria, we'd still love to hear from you—particularly if you bring unique perspectives or experiences that would strengthen our team.*

title: Lead DevOps Engineer
description:
#### **What You’ll Do**


As a Lead DevOps Engineer, you’ll own the design, reliability, and evolution of InteractiveAI’s production infrastructure, ensuring our platform is secure, scalable, observable, and fast to ship. You’ll guide a small, high\-impact team of DevOps/SRE engineers, raising standards for uptime, deployment velocity, and operational excellence across cloud and hybrid environments.  

You’ll work closely with AI Engineers, Backend Engineers, and Product teams to support demanding workloads (including LLM/agent orchestration) while building a best\-in\-class AI engineering platform.  

Your responsibilities will include:

* Architect and evolve InteractiveAI’s core infrastructure (networking, compute, storage, Kubernetes, CI/CD) to support rapid product delivery
* Build and operate cloud\-agnostic environments (Kubernetes) across VPC, on\-prem, and hybrid deployments
* Implement and maintain CI/CD for services and infrastructure (GitOps preferred), enabling safe and frequent deployments
* Define “gold standards” for reliability: SLOs/SLIs, incident response, on\-call practices, runbooks, and postmortems
* Establish robust observability (metrics, logs, traces) with actionable alerting and performance monitoring
* Drive infrastructure\-as\-code across environments (Terraform/Pulumi/CloudFormation), including strong review/testing practices
* Own security fundamentals: secrets management, IAM, network segmentation, vulnerability management, and compliance readiness
* Improve developer productivity with internal tooling, self\-service environments, and paved paths
* Optimize costs and capacity planning across clusters and workloads (including bursty inference/agent workloads)
* Mentor and grow a small DevOps team, fostering ownership, quality, and pragmatic execution

#### **What We’re Looking For**


We’re seeking a hands\-on technical leader with a builder’s mindset—someone who thrives in fast\-moving environments, can scale systems and practices, and can lead through influence and example.  

Minimum Requirements

* 5\+ years in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure roles
* Proven track record operating production systems with strong reliability and incident management practices
* Strong expertise with Linux, networking fundamentals, and cloud infrastructure patterns
* Deep knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience building and owning CI/CD pipelines for microservices and infrastructure
* Proficiency with infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation)
* Strong scripting/coding ability (Python, Bash, Go, or similar)
* Experience with observability stacks (Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, etc.)
* Experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Additional Requirements (Nice to Have)* Experience with service mesh, API gateways, or ingress at scale (Istio/Linkerd, NGINX, Envoy, etc.)
* Familiarity with security \& compliance practices (GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2 readiness)
* Experience supporting GPU clusters or high\-throughput compute workloads (a plus for AI platforms)
* Exposure to MLOps/LLM serving infrastructure and performance/cost optimization
* Prior experience leading or mentoring engineers (formally or informally)

#### **What You’ll Get**

* Competitive base salary (€60,000/yr to €90,000/yr) \+ performance bonuses
* Access to equity/share plan as it rolls out
* Private health insurance
* Flexible work setup \+ travel when needed (ideally Hybrid in Lisbon or Madrid)
* 23 days PTO (excluding local public holidays)

#### **Who You Are**

* Proactive \& Strategic: You anticipate scaling challenges and design systems that won’t collapse under growth.
* Technical Leader: You raise the bar with strong engineering fundamentals, clarity, and high standards.
* Accountable \& High\-Ownership: You take responsibility for uptime, security, and delivery outcomes.
* Builder Mentality: You move fast in ambiguity while keeping production safe and predictable.
* Collaborative Partner: You communicate clearly, build trust across teams, and balance pragmatism with long\-term vision.

#### **Interview Process**


We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Most candidates complete it in 2–3 weeks. Here’s what to expect:

* Intro Call – 30 minutes with our team to align on fit and expectations
* Technical Challenge – A practical DevOps/SRE design or automation task
* Technical Interview – Deep dive into infrastructure architecture, reliability, security, and delivery practices
* Leadership \& Values Interview – Assess alignment with InteractiveAI’s culture and growth mindset
* Offer – Final conversation and offer


We’re building a team of builders — people who care about impact, quality, and growth.  

If that’s you, let’s talk !#### **About us**


InteractiveAI is a fast\-growing startup on a mission to empower enterprises with fully managed AI agent lifecycles.  

We are building the next generation of enterprise\-AI solutions, delivering an end\-to\-end Agentic IDE alongside an extensible ecosystem of agentic resources and solutions.


Our platform allows companies to orchestrate, monitor, evaluate, deploy and improve AI agents—and soon fine\-tune and own their own models.

  

We value autonomy, speed, and innovation, and we’re building a world\-class team to match. Our squads are lean, focused, and execution\-driven.

  

If you thrive in high\-performance environments and want to be part of a company that rewards transformational outcomes, this is for you.

 As a Founding AI Engineer, you’ll make core decisions about how agents are structured, when to introduce sub\-agents, how context is scoped, and how systems are evaluated and improved over time. You’ll work across models, backend systems, voice pipelines, and integrations to ensure our AI operators behave predictably and perform at production\-grade quality.

 We’re looking for extraordinary talent\-people who do their best work when the problems are hard, the context is scarce, and the pace is unforgiving. There’s no playbook here. You’ll help write it. * Startup velocity: comfortable with ambiguity, rapid iteration, and wearing multiple hats

* Join as the first hire at a high\-ambition startup backed by top\-tier investors from Silicon Valley.

* Translate regulatory, risk, and business requirements into clear product requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Prioritize and manage backlogs, define MVPs, and drive iterative delivery with engineering, data science, and platform teams.
* Coordinate complex, multi\-stakeholder delivery in a matrix organization, including change management, training, and adoption plans.


**Enterprise Readiness \& Compliance**
* Embed compliance, safeguarding, and responsible AI requirements into product design from day one (data protection, explainability, guardrails, audit trails, approvals).
* Work with legal, compliance, information security, and model risk management to define and implement appropriate controls and governance for AI products in financial services.
* Ensure all AI solutions meet internal policies and external regulations (e.g., data residency, model risk, record keeping, retention, and auditability).


**Technical \& Platform Collaboration**
* Partner with AI platform and engineering teams using Azure, AWS, and Databricks to define reference architectures and reusable building blocks for AI solutions.
* Understand trade\-offs between cloud services (e.g., Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Azure Databricks, AWS AI services, Google Cloud AI) to make informed product decisions.
* Shape requirements around observability, monitoring, logging, and MLOps so AI systems are supportable in production, not just proof\-of\-concept.


**Value Realization \& Risk Management**
* Define product success metrics (adoption, automation rate, risk reduction, operational efficiency, user satisfaction) and track them rigorously.
* Identify, map, and manage risks (technical, operational, regulatory) throughout the lifecycle of AI initiatives.
* Communicate progress and risk status to senior stakeholders through clear, structured reporting and program governance.


**Experience**
**What You Bring**
* Several years of experience as a Product Manager, Program Manager, or similar role delivering digital or data/AI products in a large enterprise.
* Experience working in financial services or other strongly regulated industries.

Global Supply Chain is a critical value driver for GSK, responsible for delivering billions of doses and medicines globally with the highest standards of quality, reliability, and efficiency.

**Position Summary**
====================

  

GSK is a science\-led global healthcare company with a clear purpose to help people do more, feel better, and live longer. As part of our Enterprise AI organization, we are accelerating an enterprise\-wide transformation to embed data, analytics, and artificial intelligence into the core of how GSK operates.


We are seeking a visionary and execution\-oriented Vice President, Global Supply Chain Data \& AI to lead this transformation across GSK’s end\-to\-end supply chain, spanning manufacturing, quality, engineering, planning, logistics, and external supply.


This is a senior executive leadership role within GSK’s Enterprise AI team, working in close partnership with Global Supply Chain leadership and Digital \& Tech. The role is accountable for translating enterprise AI strategy into measurable P\&L, service, and resilience outcomes across a complex, regulated, global supply chain network that includes more than 37 sites, thousands of suppliers, and critical product launches across Vaccines, Specialty Medicines, and General Medicines.


As AI increasingly moves from digital decision support into the physical world of manufacturing, quality, and logistics, this role will help shape how emerging capabilities — including industrial AI, intelligent automation, robotics\-enabled processes, and cyber\-physical systems — are responsibly integrated into GSK’s global supply chain. The role does not require deep hands\-on expertise in every emerging technology, but does require strong technical judgment, curiosity, and the ability to partner with domain experts across IT, OT, engineering, and manufacturing to translate innovation into scalable, compliant impact.


The VP, Global Supply Chain Data \& AI will define strategy, build and scale AI products, lead high\-performing global teams, and ensure AI solutions move from pilots to sustained production impact.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================


Enterprise AI Strategy for Supply Chain

* Define and own the Global Supply Chain Data \& AI strategy aligned to GSK Enterprise AI and Global Supply Chain priorities.
* Translate strategy into a multi\-year roadmap focused on inventory reduction, yield improvement, service level performance, cycle time reduction, cost productivity, and supply resilience.
* Shape GSK’s long\-term vision for AI\-enabled physical supply chains, including the role of industrial AI, intelligent automation, and cyber\-physical systems alongside digital analytics.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
   

  

 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
   

  

 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer\-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission\-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 Much of our work takes place in high\-security on\-premise environments, and we are looking for Site Reliability Engineer to support our high security environments.
   

  

 Your role as a Site Reliability Engineer will be to design, implement, and manage our on\-premise Kubernetes infrastructure.
   

  

 We are looking for engineers with a strong work ethic and prioritisation skills. We value team players who communicate clearly, share knowledge generously, and collaborate effectively to move their team — and our mission—forward.
   

  

 The day\-to\-day
   

  

* As a SRE, you will design and build cloud\-native infrastructure platforms on\-premises, focusing on Kubernetes\-based solutions that enable our development teams to operate services at scale.
* You will create robust observability frameworks using Grafana, Prometheus, and distributed tracing to ensure system reliability and performance
* You will architect and implement secure, multi\-tenant Kubernetes clusters with strong access controls, policy\-as\-code governance, and zero\-trust networking between red and black network domains. You will develop operators and controllers to automate infrastructure provisioning and compliance
* You will build and maintain MLOps platforms enabling AI researchers to deploy, monitor, and scale machine learning models in production.
* You will collaborate closely with our Security teams to implement supply chain security, container scanning, and runtime protection across our cloud\-native stack


 Key Skills
   

  

* Scripting: experience in either Python, Go, Rust or Bash/ Shell for automation and tooling
* Experience with GitOps workflows and CI/CD automation
* Kubernetes Expertise: deep experience operating production Kubernetes clusters, writing custom controllers/operators, and implementing service mesh architectures (Istio/Linkerd)
* Cloud\-Native Technologies: hands\-on experience with CNCF ecosystem, e.g. including Helm, ArgoCD, Flux and container runtime security tools like Falco
* Observability Stack: expert\-level knowledge of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, and OpenTelemetry. Experience building custom dashboards, alerts, and SLI/SLO frameworks
* Networking: Expert understanding of networking concepts, protocols and security
* MLOps Platforms: experience with Kubeflow, MLflow, or similar platforms
* Infrastructure as Code: proficiency with Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes manifest templating. Experience with policy\-as\-code tools like OPA/Gatekeeper
* System Administration: deep understanding of Linux/Unix system administration and highly available, distributed systems
* Comfortable building out data and telemetry pipelines for debugging and future\-proofing solutions


 You should apply if you
   

  

* Have a high level of personal integrity, reliability, and attention to detail
* Have a software engineering mindset with a passion for building platforms and tools that multiply developer productivity
* Have experience running cloud\-native workloads in on\-premises or air\-gapped environments
* Are willing to relocate to Munich, London, or Paris.


 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer\-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission\-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
   

  

**The role**
 Software only matters when it is actively being used and making a difference. As a Deployed AI Engineer, you will be at the heart of this \- taking state\-of\-the\-art software, and integrating it into complex systems. You'll be defining and executing against the end\-to\-end outcome, and all steps on the way, to delivering novel capabilities in some of the most challenging environments around.
   

  

 For example: you collaborate directly with customer avionics engineers to understand the data structures and APIs used in aircraft mission control systems. Instead of being scared, you embrace the complexity of unfamiliar databases, APIs, or network protocols; you dig into the specification and use your creativity and ingenuity to implement adapters for integrating them with Helsing’s cloud infrastructure. By working closely with our partners and customers (both metaphorically and quite literally), you continuously evolve, improve, and operate Helsing software. You own the outcome end\-to\-end.
   

  

**The day\-to\-day**
 In close collaboration with our product teams, you discover and formalise customer requirements, identify bugs, and ship the latest features directly to our users. Technology demonstrations are our chance to shine \- you will coordinate between customers, partners, and Helsing engineers to showcase Helsing’s software and AI capabilities in simulations or with real systems.
   

  

 You should apply if you
   

  

* Have a degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, or other relevant fields.
* Have broad understanding and creative use of computer systems; this is the Swiss army knife in Helsing’s toolbox of world\-class talent.
* Prefer asking questions over stipulating answers.
* Love figuring things out, digging deeper and deeper into unfamiliar systems until it finally clicks, and you understand how they work.
* Are not afraid of legacy systems and would rather make them work than give up and try to rewrite it all
* Are comfortable with scripting languages such as Bash or Python and have experience with software engineering in C\+\+, Java, Rust, or similar.
* Can navigate and configure Linux systems and have an understanding of network stacks and database systems.
* If applying for Germany\- it is a requirement that you are able to speak business level or fluent German


*Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systemically under\-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.*
 Join Helsing and work with world\-leading experts in their fields
   

  

* Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.
* The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.
* Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.
* In our domain, success is a matter of order\-of\-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts.
* We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about.


 What we offer
   

  

* A focus on outcomes, not time\-tracking
* Competitive compensation and stock options
* Relocation support
* Social and education allowances
* Regular company events and all\-hands to bring together employees as one team across Europe
* A hands\-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done \- all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one


*Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.*

Mod Op is redefining how marketing gets done. We’re building AI\-enabled solutions that transform creativity, strategy, and execution. We are reimagining how the agency\-client and business\-consumer/client value equation looks, feels and delivers unforgettable experiences and services at scale.

  

As an AI Engineer on Mod Op’s Innovation Team, you’ll help build the future of marketing by combining data, behavioral insights, and cutting\-edge AI technology to create intelligent tools and agents that elevate creativity, drive efficiency, and unlock growth for global brands.

  

You’ll work alongside strategists, data scientists, creatives, and technologists to design and deploy bespoke AI solutions that scale across industries like CPG, entertainment, food \& beverage, and B2B. Your curiosity about human behavior and your drive to experiment will power innovations that reshape how customers discover, engage with, and buy products and services.

  

This is not a lab role. It is a build, test, learn, and ship role. You’ll help Mod Op and our clients evolve faster, smarter, and more humanly.

**Responsibilities**


Design comprehensive AI system architectures, taking responsibility for selecting models (e.g., LLMs, traditional ML, or hybrid approaches), determining the use of RAG versus fine\-tuning or agentic workflows, and overseeing data pipelines, vector stores, orchestration, and observability.

Partner with product, strategy, and executive stakeholders to define the problems at hand, transform ambiguous goals into specific solutions and requirements, and establish and promote shared success metrics.

Evaluate cost\-to\-value tradeoffs, incorporating active optimization of token usage, caching strategies, and model routing, while also considering future growth plans.

Software Delivery \& Collaboration Practices

* Proficiency in Agile development methodologies
* Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git)

Marketing Technology

-----------------


Ready to push the limits of what’s possible? Join Sanofi in one of our corporate functions and you can play a vital part in the performance of our entire business while helping to make an impact on millions around the world.

Our life\-changing and lifesaving products are grounded in science that Canadians can trust. They empower self\-care, prevent and treat diseases, and help people live better.

Sanofi has embarked into a vast and ambitious digital transformation program. A cornerstone of this roadmap is the acceleration of its data transformation and of the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) solutions. This opportunity will allow for personal and professional growth, as no two experiences will be alike and you'll have the opportunity to carve your own path. You'll work with multi\-faceted teams to design and build AI products, create cutting\-edge, scalable platforms, and enable Sanofi to make the best value of data, transforming people's lives in 90\+ countries around the global. Whatever projects you're working on, you'll learn from world\-class leaders who come from industry and academia backgrounds, pushing you to stretch your goals and achieve your best.


As a member of Sanofi's Global AI Centre of Excellence in Toronto, you will be working on a team that is globally diverse, with members here in Toronto as well as across our global hubs in France, Spain and USA. You'll be engaged in a structured program that's focused on driving the growth of your technical knowledge and business acumen. Based on your skills and background, you'll be aligned to one of Sanofi's five core data and AI functions to deliver on meaningful strategic initiatives \- whether that be in data science, data and business analysis, data and ML engineering, software engineering, or data and AI strategy. This approach ensures that you specialize in your area of interest, while being engaged as part of a larger cohort of colleagues to collectively build core skills in strategic problem solving, product design, agile ways of working, and leadership. Upon completion of the two years, you'll be provided the opportunity to a preferred position, responding to Sanofi's business needs.

  

Data and AI Engineer – AI Workflows Focus


As a Data and AI Engineer within the Data and AI Future Catalyst Program, you'll have the opportunity to work specifically on **AI Workflow initiatives** that are transforming how Sanofi modernizes core business processes through workflow automation and AI. You'll be part of the **AI Workflow Accelerator** program, working to simplify, rationalize, and augment strategic processes using digital and AI technologies.


Your focus will be on initiatives to reimagine and redesign core business processes using AI.  

  

You'll collaborate directly with **Global Business Process Owners (GBPOs)** to redesign processes using a zero\-based approach, creating modern, future\-facing capabilities. Your work will involve building consumer\-grade interfaces that are intuitive for all users, developing omnichannel experiences, and creating modular agentic AI solutions that integrate seamlessly with existing data foundations.


This role offers the unique opportunity to work on process modernization at scale, building AI\-first processes where AI agents execute workflows with appropriate human oversight, and contributing to Sanofi's vision of becoming a truly AI\-enabled enterprise.


We are an innovative global healthcare company with one purpose: to chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. **Your role at GEI.**  

  

The AI Engineer is responsible for the development of AI solutions, typically leveraging pretrained models and copilots, to support GEI’s priority digital and AI initiatives. This role focuses on building, deploying, and integrating AI capabilities into business workflows in a secure, scalable, and maintainable manner.  

  

The AI Engineer plays a hands\-on role in active AI Solutions Factory use cases by implementing AI\-based solutions, integrating enterprise data sources, and supporting solution reliability and performance. This role works closely with solution architects and platform teams to ensure AI solutions are production\-ready, aligned with GEI standards, and capable of scaling across use cases.  

  

**Essential Responsibilities \& Duties**  

* Build and deploy AI\-based solutions using pretrained models and Copilot technologies.
* Design and implement prompt flows, plugins, and orchestrations using Copilot Studio and Azure Functions.
* Integrate AI capabilities into business workflows and applications.
* Integrate enterprise data sources securely, including APIs, Graph connectors, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and event\-driven patterns.
* Maintain and optimize Power BI dashboards that support AI\-enabled workflows and insights.
* Instrument AI solutions for telemetry, reliability, performance monitoring, and cost control.
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting for deployed AI solutions.
* Identify implementation risks and support mitigation strategies in collaboration with architecture and platform teams.

* 4\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 1 year building Generative AI applications.

Restaurant Brands International Inc. is one of the world's largest quick service restaurant companies with nearly $45 billion in annual system\-wide sales and over 32,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories.


RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities.


RBI is committed to growing the TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES® and FIREHOUSE SUBS® brands by leveraging their respective core values, employee and franchisee relationships, and long track records of community support. Each brand benefits from the global scale and shared best practices that come from ownership by Restaurant Brands International Inc.


We’re looking for a Sr. Manager, People Analytics to elevate RBI’s talent strategy through data\-driven insights, executive storytelling, and enterprise\-scale analytics solutions. This role will lead high\-impact analytics projects, scale self\-service infrastructure, and deliver actionable workforce insights to senior HR and business leaders.


You’ll manage a growing team of two direct reports and play a key role in advancing a data\-first culture across the People function. You’ll partner closely with HR Tech, Talent, and business leaders to design and execute initiatives across the full employee lifecycle, including talent acquisition, mobility, performance, engagement, and retention.


A key part of this role is identifying where AI tools can help improve reporting, insights, and day\-to\-day work. You don’t need to be an AI engineer, but you should be comfortable evaluating how tools like ChatGPT or One Model’s AI Assistant can support our processes and help bring those ideas to life.


A key part of this role is helping the People Analytics space understand and apply AI in practical ways. You’ll introduce and scale AI methods that improve the quality of insights, expand automation, and support better decision\-making across RBI.


Proficiency in Python is required, as you'll work hands\-on to automate and scale analytics tools. Experience with Workday Report Writer is strongly preferred.


This position is based in **Miami, FL or Toronto, ON** and is in the office **5 days a week**.


Role and Responsibilities:

* Lead end\-to\-end people analytics projects \- from intake and scoping to delivery \- across dashboards, KPIs, predictive models, and ad\-hoc insights
* Spot opportunities where AI tools can improve analytics, reporting, or workflow efficiency, and help design solutions with the team
* Define and maintain core talent metrics, aligning with HR and business priorities to support data\-driven decision\-making
* Deliver executive\- and board\-level presentations and materials to support strategic workforce planning
* Manage and coach a Sr. Analyst and Analyst, developing technical skills, business acumen, and insight fluency
* Design and scale self\-service tools and dashboards (e.g., One Model), ensuring usability and data quality across functions
* Oversee Workday reporting, including calculated fields, and collaborate with HR Tech on reporting enhancements and governance
* Build and automate reporting workflows using Python and SQL; support data pipelines and large\-scale HR data transformation
* Translate complex analytics into clear, actionable narratives that address the “so what” and “now what” for stakeholders
* Establish intake and prioritization processes to manage cross\-functional reporting needs effectively
* Continuously improve data quality and infrastructure across systems to support enterprise analytics
* Lead delivery of regulatory reports, SOX controls, and standard People reports with consistency and accuracy


Qualifications and Skills:

* 6\+ years of experience in People Analytics, Workforce Planning, HR Strategy, or a related analytics field
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Statistics, HR Analytics, or related field
* Advanced proficiency in Python (automation, modeling, transformation); SQL experience a plus
* Strong expertise in Workday Report Writer; familiarity with One Model, Power BI, or similar tools
* Experience creating and scaling KPI frameworks, self\-service tools, and dashboards for HR and business partners
* Familiarity with AI tools like ChatGPT or other generative AI assistants, and the ability to apply them to solve real HR and analytics challenges
* Proven ability to coach and manage analytics talent, including analysts and junior team members
* Excellent storytelling and data visualization skills \- can translate insights into action for senior audiences
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and proactive in managing multiple high\-priority projects
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and leading through change in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment


Why Join Us?


You’ll help HR and business leaders understand the trends that matter \- what drives turnover, how to improve hiring funnels, and how to strengthen engagement \- by building clean dashboards, accurate KPIs, and insights supported by practical AI tools.


Benefits at all of our global offices are focused on physical, mental and financial wellness. We offer unique and progressive benefits, including a comprehensive global paid parental leave program that supports employees as they expand their families, free telemedicine and mental wellness support.

Citi is a world\-leading global bank. We have approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 100 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. We provide consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. We enable clients to achieve their strategic financial objectives by providing them with cutting\-edge ideas, best\-in\-class products and solutions, and unparalleled access to capital and liquidity.

**Overview of the organization:**


The COO Enterprise Solution Engineering capability is responsible for the development of best\-in\-class technology platforms for Operations, including development of an integrated portfolio of Operations tools, end\-to\-end solution design for large scale transformation initiatives, design governance, and adoption of Generative AI solutions for driving operational efficiencies.

**Role**:

* Experience with build and deployment (CI/CD) tools such as Jenkins and Gradle.

* Apply your continually improving understanding of knowledge of EDC’s software, SDLC practices, and the industry in general.
* Actively participate in knowledge\-sharing sessions as a presenter and as an attendee practicing continuous learning.

This role focuses on building, deploying, and integrating AI capabilities into business workflows in a secure, scalable, and maintainable manner.
   

  

 The AI Engineer plays a hands\-on role in active AI Solutions Factory use cases by implementing AI\-based solutions, integrating enterprise data sources, and supporting solution reliability and performance. This role works closely with solution architects and platform teams to ensure AI solutions are production\-ready, aligned with GEI standards, and capable of scaling across use cases.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities \& Duties**
* Build and deploy AI\-based solutions using pretrained models and Copilot technologies.
* Design and implement prompt flows, plugins, and orchestrations using Copilot Studio and Azure Functions.
* Integrate AI capabilities into business workflows and applications.
* Integrate enterprise data sources securely, including APIs, Graph connectors, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and event\-driven patterns.
* Maintain and optimize Power BI dashboards that support AI\-enabled workflows and insights.
* Instrument AI solutions for telemetry, reliability, performance monitoring, and cost control.
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting for deployed AI solutions.
* Identify implementation risks and support mitigation strategies in collaboration with architecture and platform teams.


**Minimum Qualifications**

* Experience delivering Generative AI (LLM) solutions, preferably on Azure.
* Familiarity with Azure AI library APIs, including GPT, Codex, and DALL·E, and other frameworks (e.g., Databricks Mosaic) for integrating Generative AI into business workflows.

description:
**About Us**



At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive "sick\-care" to proactive health care. Our award\-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non\-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient\-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against "we caught it too late again".


**We are looking for a contract based Radiology Annotation Specialist and Anatomist** to join our dynamic Annotation Team. In this critical role, you will play a key part in labeling and annotating radiology data, ensuring the accuracy of ground truth to support the development of cutting\-edge AI\-driven medical imaging models.


**This is an independent contractor role**, **with variable project hours ranging from 15 to 40 hours per week, depending on workload and business priorities**. The contract will continue for the duration of the project or until business needs evolve, with the potential for extension or early termination based on organizational requirements.



This position is preferably based in **Vancouver** for an on\-site setting, allowing for seamless collaboration with our expert teams.



Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting\-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise \- join us to make a difference in people's lives!

  

**What You'll Do**


* Annotate MRI or other radiological images across different anatomical structures, tissues, organs and pathologies ensuring high accuracy across various MRI sequences.
* Collaborate with radiologists and medical experts to refine annotation strategies and enhance labeling precision.
* Review, identify, and address discrepancies in annotated data, providing feedback to improve overall annotation accuracy.
* Develop and update annotation guidelines, tracking sheets and other relevant documentation, implement quality control measures ensuring best practices in radiology image annotation for AI applications.


**What You'll Bring**


* A degree as a medical doctor (MD) is preferred, alternatively Bachelor's, Master's or PhD in a relevant field with demonstrable knowledge of anatomy, pathology and radiological imaging, particularly sectional anatomy in MRI imaging either through work experience or coursework.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to accurately interpret and annotate medical images, particularly in MRI.
* Deep understanding of medical terminology, diseases, and diagnostic imaging modalities.
* Excellent communication skills to collaborate with radiologists, AI engineers, regulatory personnel and other stakeholders.
* Exceptional attention to detail with a keen eye for identifying inconsistencies in annotated data.
* Prior experience in healthcare, particularly radiology, medical imaging, or AI\-driven annotation, is highly desirable.
* Previous experience reading and annotating MRI images using specialized annotation tools.
* Passion for Prenuvo's mission and a strong commitment to improving healthcare through AI\-driven innovation and research.


**Our Values**



First: we are **Pioneers**

**About Landing AI**
 LandingAI has always been a Visual AI company solving vision problems. We treat documents as visual artifacts and have taken on the challenge of systematically solving problems within the document understanding space. Overall, we are building foundational infrastructure for developers to extract information from their images and documents.
   

  

**Our roots:**
* An early pioneer in Agentic AI , which we have applied in practice with Agentic Document Extraction (ADE).
* Our LandingLens product, which has helped healthcare, finance, legal, and manufacturing teams address their visual AI challenges, maturing us in data\-centric practices.
* A vision\-first approach, now applied to building our in\-house foundation models.


 These three pillars—agentic AI, data\-centric obsession, and a vision\-first approach—inform our ADE product and this is what you will deeply experience while working at LandingAI.
   

  

 Founded by
 **Andrew Ng,** 
 one of the world’s leading AI researchers, LandingAI is committed to bringing cutting\-edge research into production to solve real\-world problems at scale.
   

  

 We love and appreciate leadership, ownership, and founder energy. We value people with the guts to stand by their work and deliver, rather than offering empty talk. If this is you, you are already a culture fit and we would love to talk more.
   

  

**About the Role:**
 We are looking for a passionate
 **Applied AI Engineer** 
 with strong expertise in document processing, LLMs, NLP, and multimodal AI. This role sits at the intersection of
 **engineering, product, customer success, and sales** 
 , contributing both to technical innovation and to strategic, customer\-facing engagements.
   

  

 You will design and implement state\-of\-the\-art document AI solutions, lead pre\-sales technical efforts, and ensure successful deployments that drive measurable business outcomes for customers. You’ll work cross\-functionally with product, engineering, GTM, and partners to help shape the future of our ADE platform.
   

  

**What You’ll Do:**
* Take ownership of pre\-sales technical engagements and help develop technical champions at prospects, customers, and partners.
* Engage directly with customers to understand business challenges and design custom demos and POCs leveraging ADE (schema\-based extraction, validation, grounding).
* Lead client presentations, whiteboard sessions, and technical workshops, clearly communicating ADE’s value and differentiators.
* Design, develop, and deploy document AI and multimodal pipelines (OCR, LLM reasoning, validation, workflow integration).

* Collaborate with Sales to articulate technical and business value, supporting executive briefings, proposals, and ROI analyses.
* Provide structured customer feedback to Product and Engineering, shaping roadmap priorities (schemas, retrieval, grounding, integrations).
* Partner with ISVs, OEMs, and SIs to extend ADE into verticalized solutions (invoices, contracts, financial reporting).
* Stay up to date with LLMs, agentic AI, and document processing frameworks, applying cutting\-edge innovations to ADE.
* Contribute to white papers, case studies, and technical blogs highlighting customer success stories.
* Mentor teammates and foster excellence in agentic workflows and document AI best practices.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in CS, Engineering, or a quantitative field, with a strong focus on ML/AI (LLMs, NLP, multimodal AI).

* Minimum 2 years of experience with cloud data platforms, preferably Snowflake.
* Understanding of enterprise sales processes (MEDDIC) and experience supporting sales teams in technical deal cycles.
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, able to explain complex AI workflows (RAG, schema validation, grounding) to both technical and business audiences.
* Hands\-on experience with containerization, REST APIs, and cloud deployment strategies.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with a passion for applied AI and customer impact.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects in a dynamic environment.


**Nice\-to\-Have:**
* Deep understanding of ML algorithms and deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and computer vision techniques (OCR, detection, segmentation, etc.).
* Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG systems, schema\-based extraction, and agentic AI frameworks.
* Experience with document AI competitors (Instabase, hyperscaler Doc AI, KVP extraction tools) and ability to articulate LandingAI differentiation.
* Experience with cloud computing (AWS, GCP, Azure) and enterprise VPC deployments.
* Strong Python programming skills, plus familiarity with JavaScript, C\#, or workflow automation tools.
* Prior work with OCR, NLP, and multimodal AI for unstructured documents (PDFs, images, audio, etc.).
* Linux experience is a plus.

description:
**Description**  



  

**Your role at GEI.**  

  

The AI Solutions Lead is responsible for leading GEI’s AI solutions delivery model and managing the AI Solutions Factory, which builds and operationalizes AI capabilities in support of GEI and select enterprise initiatives. This role provides day\-to\-day leadership of the factory team, ensuring AI solutions are delivered with high quality, scalability, security, and alignment to GEI technology and governance standards.  

  

The AI Solutions Lead partners closely with GEI and enterprise stakeholders, receiving prioritized AI initiatives from the AI Solutions Coordination Center and leading their execution through the AI Solutions Factory. Acting as a bridge between innovation, delivery, and IT governance, this role ensures AI concepts and pilots are translated into repeatable, production\-ready solutions while protecting GEI\-specific priorities and delivery needs.  

  

**Essential Responsibilities \& Duties**  

* Lead the overall operation and execution of GEI’s AI Solutions Factory, ensuring consistent delivery, quality, and throughput across AI initiatives.
* Manage, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary AI delivery team, including solution architects, AI engineers, and full stack engineers.
* Define, prioritize, and sequence AI use cases in collaboration with business, digital, and IT stakeholders, maintaining strong intake discipline and delivery focus.
* Support the creation of a digital roadmap for GEI, from concept to deployment: prioritize initiatives, build business cases, manage change, and scale digital transformation.
* Establish and maintain delivery processes, standards, and performance expectations for AI solution development and deployment.
* Be accountable for the quality, usability, and production readiness of AI solutions delivered by the team, ensuring solutions meet defined user requirements, architectural standards, and enterprise expectations.
* Ensure AI solutions comply with enterprise governance, security, privacy, and responsible AI standards.
* Partner closely with IT leadership to align AI innovation with enterprise platforms, data architecture, cybersecurity, and operational requirements.
* Track delivery progress, risks, and outcomes, and communicate status, insights, and recommendations to executive stakeholders.
* Ensure reusable patterns, components, and delivery practices are captured and leveraged to accelerate future AI initiatives and reduce duplication.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

* 15\+ years of relevant experience in digital, technology, or engineering delivery roles, including at least 5\+ years leading high\-performing, multidisciplinary teams.
* Demonstrated experience leading AI, advanced analytics, or digital solution delivery in complex enterprise environments.
* Proven ability to manage distributed teams and stakeholders across multiple time zones, with comfort leading in remote and hybrid environments.
* Strong understanding of AI solution architectures, including cloud\-based AI platforms, data foundations, model lifecycle considerations, and enterprise integration.
* Familiarity with Microsoft\-centric AI and cloud platforms, such as Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, large language models (LLMs), and agent\-based or workflow\-driven AI solutions.
* Experience partnering with IT, security, and governance teams to ensure digital initiatives are both innovative and technically sound.

 Build production AI systems that make the building materials supply chain radically more intelligent—
 **faster decisions, better pricing, higher win rates, fewer mistakes**

 What you’ll build (real systems, shipped to customers)

* Optimize for margin
 *and* 
 conversion—not vanity accuracy



**2\) Sales \+ Support Agents that contractors don’t hate**

* Quote jobs, answer spec questions, find substitutes, and know when to escalate

**3\) Demand forecasting for “weird inventory”** 




 We specialize in discontinued/hard\-to\-find products where classic forecasting breaks.
 


* Predict demand signals earlier than the market
* Model substitutions and cross\-SKU relationships
* Use messy, real\-world signals (not clean textbook datasets)



**4\) Procurement Copilot for full\-project sourcing** 



* Help buyers spec an entire job
* Recommend substitutes when items are unavailable
* Optimize for cost \+ availability \+ lead time \+ constraints



**5\) The unglamorous but critical parts** 



* Evals, monitoring, regression testing, and guardrails
* Latency \+ cost optimization (LLMs aren’t free)
* Data pipelines and feedback loops that compound advantage



 This is not research. These systems will be in production and used by real customers—fast.
 



 What “great” looks like in this role
 



 Within months, your work should visibly change the business. Examples:
 


* Pricing suggestions that reliably improve margin and/or conversion
* Support response times dropping from minutes to seconds without sacrificing trust
* A procurement copilot that turns multi\-hour sourcing into a workflow measured in minutes
* A measurement and evaluation stack that keeps quality stable as product changes weekly



  





 Who this is for
 



 This role fits you if you:
 


* Have shipped
 **LLM\-based products** 
 to production (not “a demo,” not “a notebook”)
* Can handle being the only AI specialist in the room—while partnering tightly with product/engineering/operators
* Like ambiguity because you’re good at turning ambiguity into shipped software
* Care about outcomes: margin, conversion, speed, trust, retention
* Have strong product taste
 *and* 
 strong engineering execution



 What we’re looking for (technical)
 


* Strong Python \+ ability to build production services (APIs, data flows, observability)
* LLM application development: RAG, agents, tool/function calling, routing, evals
* Comfort with the hard tradeoffs: latency, reliability, unit economics, security, monitoring
* Experience with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow) is useful—pragmatism matters more than brand names



**Bonus points** 
 if you’ve worked on:
 


* Voice AI / real\-time agents
* Multi\-modal workflows (images/spec sheets/PDFs)
* Marketplace pricing systems, supply chain, procurement, or ML Ops at scale



 What we don’t care about
 


* Your degree
* Whether you’ve worked at a “name brand” company
* Years of experience as a proxy for ability



  





 We care about what you’ve built, how you think, and whether you can ship.
 



 Why Arbor
 



**A real wedge:** 
 We’re not “a construction app.” We move physical inventory and sit directly in the decision path: what to buy, when, from whom, and at what price.
 



**A compounding data advantage:** 
 Every quote, substitution, purchase order, lead time, and customer question becomes signal—if you build the system correctly.
 



**Founding\-level ownership:** 
 You’ll define the AI roadmap, architecture, and quality bar. If we’re right, you’ll also help build the team.
 



**No cosplay:** 
 No committees, no AI theater, no slide decks pretending to be progress. We ship.
 



  





 Compensation
 



 Competitive salary \+ meaningful equity. If you want the highest upside of your career, you want ownership this early.
 



 If you’re considering applying
 



 If you want a role where you can point to a living system and say “I built the intelligence that runs this marketplace,” you’ll like it here.

This isn’t just a job; it’s a career\-defining opportunity to be part of a team transforming how the world connects with brands.
 



  





**About the Role** 



* **AI Model Development \& Integration:** 
 Design, develop, and integrate AI models, primarily utilizing GPT and other large language models (LLMs), into our core SaaS platform. This includes implementing features such as intelligent chatbots, automated ticket routing, sentiment analysis, personalized recommendations and proactive customer support.
* **Tool Calling Implementation:** 
 Develop and integrate AI solutions utilizing Tool Calling functionalities within GPT integrations. This will involve connecting our AI models to external tools and APIs to enhance their capabilities and enable more complex interactions.
* **Data Management \& Analysis:** 
 Work with large datasets related to customer interactions, product information, and retail transactions. Leverage your data analysis skills to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform AI model training and optimization. A strong understanding of retail customer journeys and common customer service issues within the retail industry is crucial.
* **Database Expertise:** 
 Utilize and manage Vector Databases to store and retrieve embeddings for efficient similarity search and context management for AI models. Experience with Graph Databases and RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) techniques is highly desirable.
* **Serverless Architecture:** 
 Design and implement AI solutions using serverless technologies, primarily Cloudflare Workers and AWS Lambda. This will involve creating scalable, efficient, and cost\-effective AI\-powered services.
* **Collaboration:** 
 Work closely with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to translate business requirements into technical specifications and deliver high\-quality AI features.
* **Performance Optimization:** 
 Continuously monitor, evaluate, and optimize the performance of AI models and integrations, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.
* **Stay Current:** 
 Keep abreast of the latest advancements in AI, machine learning, and natural language processing, and proactively identify opportunities to incorporate new technologies and techniques into our platform.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience:** 



* **Proven AI Experience:** 
 Demonstrated experience in developing and deploying AI solutions, with a strong focus on GPT integrations and Tool Calling functionalities.
* **Database Proficiency:** 
 Strong experience working with Vector Databases. Experience with Graph Databases (and RAG implementation) is highly desirable. Experience with traditional relational SQL Server/Postgres SQL databases.
* **Serverless Development:** 
 Experience with serverless technologies, specifically Cloudflare Workers.
* **Programming Languages:** 
 Proficiency in Rest APIs, Typescript, JavaScript, CSS and HTML. Experience with C\# .NET Core is a strong plus.
* **AI Regulations / Security:** 
 Understanding of AI risk assessment, legal regulations, configuring Guardrails and familiarity with common attack methods against AI systems (e.g. adversarial attacks, data poisoning)
* **Data Analysis:** 
 Strong data analysis skills, with a proven ability to extract insights from large datasets. Experience in the retail sector and understanding of retail customer journeys is essential.
* **Problem\-Solving:** 
 Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to quickly understand and address complex technical challenges.
* **Communication:** 
 Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively work in a team environment.
* **Bachelor's Degree:** 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field. (Master's degree or PhD preferred, but not required if significant practical experience is demonstrated).



  





**Highly Desirable Skills:** 



* Experience with SPARQL or Gremlin query languages for Graph Databases.
* Experience with any of the major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Contributions to open\-source AI projects.
* Experience working in an Agile development environment.
* Experience developing business\-to\-consumer (B2C) SaaS products, particularly in customer service.



  





**Summary of Benefits** 



* A dynamic \& forward\-thinking organization revolutionizing retail technology
* A virtual workforce, remote but highly interactive and collaborative
* Competitive salary and benefits
* Be a part of an amazing culture with a high client and staff retention
* Take pride in partnering with the most prestigious brands in the world
* Career progression and longevity



  





**About Powerfront** 




 Powerfront is a leading provider of customer engagement technology and solutions. The company’s proprietary engagement software INSIDE™ provides real\-time actionable intelligence that beautifully orchestrates an expanding ecosystem of communication platforms that has transformed the online retail experience.
 



  





 INSIDE can be leveraged in a variety of configurations to meet customers’ needs. Its open architecture enables customers in the luxury retail, fashion, travel, automotive, finance, and government sectors to easily deploy direct connections to their end\-users while leveraging the power of data visualization and AI to drastically improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.

description:
At IMO Health, we combine strengths in software development, artificial intelligence, and clinical expertise to create AI\-driven solutions that enhance access to reliable health information, support clinical decision\-making, and improve patient outcomes.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Staff AI Engineer** 
 to join our Software Engineering team, with strong background in designing, building, deploying, and maintaining AI solutions in production, with an emphasis on software engineering principles. This role is critical in bridging the gap between the theoretical capabilities of AI and its practical implementation by operationalizing AI models, building AI systems that are scalable, robust, and reliable in real\-world environments.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on engineer with strong software engineering, data engineering, MLOps, DevOps, and cloud engineering expertise, capable of owning the full development lifecycle – from designing, architecting, and developing AI solutions to deployment, monitoring, and optimization. You will work closely with cross\-functional partners who research and prototype models and integrate AI features into IMO Health products.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to transition AI/ML models from prototypes into scalable, production\-ready systems.
* Lead system design and architecture discussions, bringing expertise in AI engineering, MLOps, and AI deployment best practices.
* Write high\-quality source code, including detailed documentation and high\-level technical designs in collaboration with other engineers.
* Develop and maintain AI\-driven applications, ensuring high performance, scalability, reliability, and security, optimizing for latency, throughput, and cost.
* Integrate large language models (LLMs), generative AI, and NLP solutions into IMO Health’s products, with a focus on unstructured clinical data.
* Apply containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and Infrastructure\-as\-Code to manage production environments.
* Collaborate in an Agile environment with cross\-functional teams, aligning technical solutions with product and business goals.
* Implement creative solutions to technical challenges, applying out\-of\-the\-box thinking to improve existing products.
* Conduct and lead root cause analysis on defects, ensuring fixes are implemented correctly.
* Guide Agile teams on best practices across all SDLC activities. Mentor junior developers.
* Champion technical standards and architectural alignment.
* Advocate for defining and testing Non\-Functional Requirements (Availability, Scalability, Reliability, and Maintainability).
* Collaborate with team members while fostering trust, commitment, and accountability.

* Experience in developing AI\-powered applications, including LLM integration, prompt engineering, and agentic concepts.
* Experience fine\-tuning and deploying large language models (LLMs) and generative AI solutions in production.

* Working knowledge of NLP concepts (tokenization, embeddings, classification, sequence modeling) — healthcare domain exposure is a plus.

* Experience in high\-performance, scalable system design.

* Passion for AI technologies and innovation, particularly in applications for healthcare.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills in cross\-functional, distributed teams.
* Self\-starter with the ability to work independently and contribute from day one.

* Experience with clinical or healthcare AI applications.

description:
Position Overview

This is a individual\-contributor AI Engineer role for an experienced Machine Learning Engineer / Applied AI Engineer who has designed, deployed, and operated production machine learning systems in real\-world, high\-availability environments.

The role focuses on real\-time inference, low\-latency machine learning, production AI reliability, and end\-to\-end model ownership, where performance, stability, scalability, and controlled model evolution are more important than academic experimentation.

You will own the architecture, deployment, optimisation, monitoring, and lifecycle management of real\-time AI models that operate during live voice and conversational workflows, influencing production decision\-support systems.

This role is ideal for candidates searching for:  
**AI Engineer, Principal AI Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Applied ML Engineer, NLP Engineer, Real\-Time ML Engineer, Inference Engineer, Production AI Engineer, MLOps\-aware AI Engineer.**

How We Work – Engineering Culture \& Leadership

Culture is demonstrated through production ownership, operational excellence, and technical accountability, especially when systems are live.

All engineers operate **Above the Line**, meaning:

* **Accountability** – Own problems end\-to\-end, from detection to resolution
* **Respect** – Communicate clearly, professionally, and constructively
* **Action** – Drive progress independently in fast\-moving environments
* **Feedback** – Seek continuous improvement through challenge and review
* **Ownership** – Take responsibility for system behaviour, not just code
* **Empathy** – Build AI systems that behave predictably for real users

At principal level, this means autonomous execution, sound technical judgement, and decision\-making under real\-world constraints.

What You Will Own

Applied Machine Learning \& Production AI Systems

You will:

* Architect, build, and operate production\-grade machine learning systems
* Design applied ML models for continuous real\-time inference
* Work with speech, audio, NLP, text, intent detection, sentiment analysis, and behavioural signals
* Optimise models for latency, throughput, cost efficiency, interpretability, and reliability
* Set technical direction for applied AI and ML approaches used in live systems

This role requires designing for edge cases, failure modes, degradation behaviour, and recovery, not just ideal conditions.

Real\-Time Inference \& Low\-Latency Systems

You will:

* Define and implement real\-time inference strategies (event\-driven inference, partial inputs, rolling context, sliding windows)
* Optimise ML models for low\-latency, high\-concurrency, predictable performance
* Collaborate closely with platform, infrastructure, and MLOps engineers
* Own decisions around model serving, batching, GPU utilisation, concurrency limits, and resource allocation
* Understand performance trade\-offs across CPU vs GPU inference, throughput, memory, and degradation under load

Experience with real\-time systems, streaming data, or live inference pipelines is critical.

Training, Evaluation \& Continuous Model Improvement

You will:

* Design and maintain training and retraining pipelines for structured and unstructured data
* Define model acceptance criteria, validation checks, and regression thresholds
* Establish meaningful offline and online model performance metrics
* Monitor and mitigate data drift, model drift, bias, and unintended behaviour
* Make informed decisions about when models should not be promoted or deployed

Ownership includes knowing when not to ship.

Model Lifecycle, MLOps \& Production Governance

You will:

* Own model versioning, metadata, and artifact management
* Define safe deployment strategies (canary releases, champion/challenger, staged rollouts)
* Monitor live model behaviour and intervene when performance or behaviour deviates
* Document assumptions, limitations, risks, and operational constraints
* Ensure models remain explainable, auditable, and production\-safe

This role carries responsibility for production model behaviour, not just development output.

What This Role Is Not

This role is **not**:

* A notebook\-only experimentation role
* A junior, guided, or task\-only position

This is a principal applied AI engineering role with real accountability for live systems.

Experience Required ( Principal Level)

You should bring:

* Extensive experience shipping, deploying, and operating ML models in production
* Strong applied machine learning fundamentals and engineering judgement
* Expert Python skills and deep experience with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn, Hugging Face)
* Proven experience with real\-time, streaming, or low\-latency systems
* Confidence owning decisions that affect live system performance and behaviour

Highly desirable experience:

* NLP, speech processing, conversational AI
* Inference optimisation, GPU\-based serving, or high\-throughput ML systems
* Applied experience at scale, not just prototypes

 We are a growing team looking for a
 **Senior ML Engineer** 
 in the
 **sennAI** 
 department to help us on our journey to revolutionize road freight logistics. The role is located in our
 **Berlin** 
 and
 **Barcelona** 
 offices.
   

  

**What You Will Do …**
 We are seeking a Senior ML Engineer to develop and optimize intelligent pricing systems that drive revenue growth and competitive advantage. As a Senior ML Engineer, you’ll build sophisticated algorithms and models that operate at scale in production environments. This includes designing experimentation frameworks and implementing advanced ML techniques for supply/demand forecasting and price optimization. You'll collaborate closely with the sennAI team, which is responsible for building in\-house, custom AI/ML solutions.
   

  

 In this role, you will …
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain production\-grade pricing algorithms
* Build and optimize machine learning models for supply/demand forecasting price elasticity estimation, and customer lifetime value prediction.
* Develop online learning systems such as multi\-armed bandits to dynamically optimize pricing strategies.
* Develop sophisticated experimentation and causal inference methodologies to measure the impact of pricing strategies.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product managers, and other engineering teams to translate commercial strategies into scalable solutions.
* Implement robust monitoring and alerting systems to ensure pricing models perform as expected and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Develop attribution models to measure the revenue impact of pricing decisions and algorithm improvements.
* Stay current with pricing research, economic modelling techniques, and advanced ML methodologies relevant to pricing optimization.


**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR …**
* Hands\-on experience in leading technical development of AI/ML systems for pricing or related business use cases in production environments.
* Deep understanding of machine learning and statistical modelling concepts. Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (scikit\-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, JAX).
* Strong foundation in experimental design, statistical testing, and decision\-making under uncertainty.
* Problem\-solving mindset with focus on reliability, scalability, and rapid iteration.
* Excellent communication skills, with a comfort level in explaining technical trade\-offs to diverse audiences ranging from developers to stakeholders.
